hardcodederror.description: A HardCodedError is reported when sensitive cryptographic values, such as encryption keys, passwords, IVs (Initialization Vectors), or salts, are hardcoded into the source code. Hardcoded values expose cryptographic secrets to attackers, making them easy to extract via static analysis, reverse engineering, or memory dumps. This error serves as a warning that sensitive cryptographic parameters should be dynamically generated and stored securely to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of cryptographic operations.

examples.misuse: The password entered into the init method should not be hardcoded.
The passwords used in the methods load, store, and getKey should not be hardcoded.
The password used in the constructor should never be hardcoded.
